GlotLID Corpus
	

This is the corpus used to train the open GlotLID model, a language identification model capable of classifying ~2000 labels.
The list of raw texts supported in this repository is openly available here: https://github.com/cisnlp/GlotLID/blob/main/sources.md

	
		
	
	
		Download
	

The recommended way to download the data is via git clone:
git clone https://huggingface.co/datasets/cis-lmu/glotlid-corpus

Use a Hugging Face access token as the Git… See the full description on the dataset page: https://huggingface.co/datasets/cis-lmu/glotlid-corpus.
